title: Console warnings from Java FX under Wayland
body:
### JabRef version

Latest development branch build (please note build date below)

### Operating system

GNU / Linux

### Details on version and operating system

Linux Mint Debian Edition 7, under Sway/Wayland

### Checked with the [latest development build](https://builds.jabref.org/main/) (copy version output from About dialog)

- [x] I made a backup of my libraries before testing the latest development version.
- [x] I have tested the latest development version and the problem persists

### Steps to reproduce the behaviour

1. Start JR from the console
2. Look at console

(Wild guess: These warnings might be a result of my switch to the new graphics server ecosystem (i.e. Wayland and, in my case, Sway as the compositor/window manager). I don't know about how well the X-Wayland compatibility proxy, Java (FX) support, etc. already work at the Debian level. Ubuntu has switched to Wayland by default, so perhaps these issues are relevant.)
